en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4232 - Hariz narrated from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that the Messenger of Allah (swt) prohibited eating meat raw, meaning uncooked.
The Prophet (sw) said: "It is only eaten by wild beasts."
Hariz said: "This means until it is altered by the sun or fire."
